system_prompt_additions: LOGIN PAGE: The right half of the login page contains a decorative dashboard screenshot. Do not treat this as the live application. You are on the login page when you see the Sign In form with username/password fields on the left.
CREATE DROPDOWN: After clicking the Create button, a small dropdown menu appears. Click precisely on the text 'Customer' or 'Mass Create', not on surrounding nav elements.
TOM SELECT FIELDS: Some dropdowns use the Tom Select library. Look for the .ts-control div inside .ts-wrapper. Click on the ts-control element, not the outer Bootstrap row.
